tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO, the frame filled by a hand's width of ivory silk mid-billow; disregard the chrome-sphere and wider-set framing that follows. The necklace hangs through a fold, the chain drawing a fine gold line down the fabric's wave and the pearl resting where the silk troughs, its weight dimpling the surface. 150mm macro at f/4, framed 1:1 life-size, camera level with the trough: filaments legible along the lit crest, the fold behind collapsing into soft shadow, the pearl's nacre holding one window of light. A blurred crest crosses the top-right corner, cut by both edges; the chain runs out the top of the frame.
